# WC21 · Patient 360 · Lịch sử · chưa có hoạt động

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **built (U1)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#timeline`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `PemaCRMUI.timeline(p)` with no events: the empty text "Chưa có hoạt động CSKH được ghi nhận."
- Inventory note: Empty variant of the history tab.
- Page key `patients` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor).
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"[data-modal=\"patient\"]"} → {"fill":["#new-name","Nguyễn Thử Nghiệm"]} → {"click":"[data-action=\"create-patient\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-tab=\"history\"]"} → {"wait":".content"}; it must show "Chưa có hoạt động CSKH được ghi nhận.".

## Next.js target
- Route: `/patients/[id]` · status: **built (U1)** · U step: U1
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/patients/[id]` "Patient 360" (owner U1, U3); test ids: `src/lib/ops/format.test.ts`, `src/components/ops/patient/patient-360-view.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/consult-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/plan-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/session-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/photos-tab.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/patient-tabs.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/session-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/plan-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/media-upload.test.ts`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/patients/[id]/page.tsx`

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="owner-tam">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Tìm bệnh nhân", page key "patient"
  <Button variant="quiet" old="btn btn-quiet back-to-list">"← Danh sách bệnh nhân"</Button>  // nav=patients
  <Card old="patient-hero" layout="flex row">
    <Row old="patient-hero-main" gap="20px">
      <Avatar old="avatar patient-avatar">"TN"</Avatar>
      <Eyebrow>"Hồ sơ P047 · Chưa có lịch hôm nay"</Eyebrow> /* uppercase */
      <Heading level={1}>"Nguyễn Thử Nghiệm"</Heading>
      <Text old="patient-meta">"28 tuổi · Chưa xác nhận · Chưa nhập · Bác sĩ phụ trách: BS. Tâm"</Text>
      <Row old="hero-chips" gap="6px" wrap>
        <Badge tone="brand" old="chip chip-soft">"Nám · tăng sắc tố"</Badge>
        <Badge tone="neutral" old="chip">"⚠ Cần khai thác tiền sử"</Badge>
      </Row>
    </Row>
    <Row old="patient-hero-actions" gap="8px" justify="flex-end" wrap>
      <Button variant="secondary" icon="sparkles" old="btn">"AI brief"</Button>  // modal=note
      <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Nhắn tin"</Button>  // modal=message
      <Button variant="primary" icon="plus" old="btn btn-primary">"Ghi buổi điều trị"</Button>  // tab=session
    </Row>
  </Card>
  <Row old="tabbar" gap="4px">
    <Tabs items={["Tổng quan","Tư vấn","Kế hoạch","Buổi điều trị","Ảnh trước / sau","Dịch vụ & tài chính","CRM & CSKH","Lịch sử"]} selected="Lịch sử" />  // tab
  </Row>
  <Card old="panel" title="Lịch sử hợp nhất" subtitle="Sự kiện gốc, người ghi nhận và liên kết công việc">
    <EmptyState>"Chưa có hoạt động CSKH được ghi nhận."</EmptyState>
  </Card>
  <Notice tone="info" old="toast">"Đã tạo hồ sơ demo"</Notice>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Button×4, Card×2, Badge×2, Tabs×1, EmptyState×1; shared pieces: Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Đã tạo hồ sơ demo
- Chưa có hoạt động CSKH được ghi nhận. (empty state)

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Đã tạo hồ sơ demo"
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.

## Differences from the app design
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in J8: "Đã tạo hồ sơ demo"

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
